testcase.system-out: Scenario: Restore distinct views of one part after switching windows ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/revolve/revolve-profile.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And the user creates a second window for the part through View New ✔ And the first window displays the sketch in an orthogonal view ✔ And the second window displays the part in an isometric view ✔ And the first window is active ✔ When the user switches to the second window through Home ✔ Then the second window displays its isometric view ✔ And the part's model browser is displayed ✔ When the user switches back to the first window through Home ✔ Then the first window displays its orthogonal sketch view ✔ And its sketch editing environment remains active
